description: Get upload links for photos to add to an Evite event album — the way to send a photo on the hosted connector, which cannot read files on your machine. Returns one slot per file: PUT the file to its uploadUrl (the returned curl command does it, with the exact Content-Type), then call evite_upload_photo with the slot's blobKey as blob_key. Links expire after 30 minutes. Changes nothing on Evite. Unavailable on a local install — pass path or inline to evite_upload_photo there.

files.description: The photos to upload, one slot each (at most 10).

filename.description: Filename to store the photo under — a bare name with an image extension, e.g. "photo.jpg".

mimetype.description: Image type. Default: from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

name: evite_upload_slots
